Lancaster County spreads across 944 square miles of southeastern Pennsylvania farmland, with Lancaster city at its center and boroughs like Lititz, Ephrata, and Mount Joy among Plain Sect farms. Agriculture, food processing, and tourism sustain the economy, and municipalities confine development to designated Urban and Village Growth Areas while the county has preserved over 90,000 acres of farmland, so growth-area boundaries govern what is buildable.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
